**Step: L1 regularization typically increases model bias.**

*Hint 1:* Consider how L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, affects the coefficients of a linear model. It tends to shrink some coefficients to zero, which can simplify the model but may also lead to underfitting.

*Hint 2:* Think about the trade-off between bias and variance in the context of regularization. L1 regularization can increase bias by simplifying the model, but it can also reduce variance by preventing overfitting.
